en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Zurara and Bukeyr two sons of Ayn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When one is convinced that he has increased in his Prescribed Salāt, he should not rely with it and he should re-commence his Salāt with a commencement, when it was so that he was convinced with a certainty’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn ’Udhaynah from Zurarah and ibn Bukayr ibn A’yan who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If one of you is certain that he has increased something in his obligatory Salah (prayer) he does not depend on it and performs his Salah (prayer) again if he is certain of such increase.’”
